map.Gy 是吸收剂量（每千克吸收的能量），Sv 是等效剂量（考虑生物效应加权）；组织: Gy is absorbed dose (energy absorbed per kilogram) and Sv is equivalent dose (weighted for biological effect); with a tissue weighting of 1 the two are numerically about equal.
